scope: Whether the exact published WP10 read scopes constitute a relevant fix for the observed first-choice refusal. This is a source review, not an execution or approval of the whole host closure.

findings.claim: Case read scope is ineligible before C12 preparation
findings.reviewed: The nonempty planned preparedChanges gate and owner fallback test agree. WP12 has no prepared change at its first decision-choose.

findings.claim: Evidence wrapper does not enclose the current PR reader
findings.reviewed: Missing C12 archive returns undefined from the wrapped historical resolver. BCS awaits that result, then calls currentProcurement outside the wrapper. This is bounded off-path coverage, not a claim that the wrapper is globally ineffective.

findings.claim: Other candidate scopes do not establish a benefit for this choice
findings.reviewed: No recall observation, duplicate Procurement scenario or outer active source scope is demonstrated in the actual mixed Planner/PR first-choice flow. No performance gain is inferred.

findings.claim: The first inner refusing subgate is still unknown
findings.reviewed: The terminal HTTP authority check can replace an inner result. Static metric/units fanout is a diagnostic lead, not measured runtime attribution.

findings.claim: Structural closure and prior live-lease hold remain separate
findings.reviewed: Seven direct blobs are described, none applied. This review does not certify transitive host compatibility or resolve the previously published final-await lease fence.

authority: No additional user permission is required for authorized routine WP12 work. Audit references to code approval mean technical review before changing the failed fixture, not a new user approval flow.
result: Publish and forward the exact diagnostic delta to WP10/WP11. Do not re-run the equivalent Purchase merely because unrelated scopes were published.
